String.string:
[EN] You see Titus and Elleon ahead of you.
[ES] Ves a Titus y Elleon adelante.

[EN] Enemies have spotted us.
[ES] Los enemigos nos han detectado.

[EN] Let’s go along the way.
[ES] Sigamos por aquí.

[EN] You have teleported to the second level.
[ES] Te has teletransportado al segundo nivel.

[EN] Elleon pointed at the Control System.
[ES] Elleon señaló el sistema de control.

[EN] The Control System caught on fire and stopped.
[ES] El sistema de control se incendió y se detuvo.

[EN] Enemies keep increasing.
[ES] Los enemigos siguen aumentando.

[EN] The bomb exploded.
[ES] La bomba explotó.

[EN] Go to the 3rd floor and help Elleon
[ES] Ve al tercer piso y ayuda a Elleon

[EN] Head to the center of the 3rd floor.
[ES] Dirígete al centro del tercer piso.

[EN] Defeat the enemies.
[ES] Derrota a los enemigos.

[EN] Head to the left and look for a way up.
[ES] Dirígete a la izquierda y busca una forma de subir.

[EN] Investigate the device that the enemy’s leader used.
[ES] Investiga el dispositivo que usó el líder enemigo.

[EN] Follow Elleon and use the device.
[ES] Sigue a Elleon y usa el dispositivo.

[EN] Follow Elleon.
[ES] Sigue a Elleon.

[EN] Move to where Elleon went.
[ES] Muévete hacia donde fue Elleon.

[EN] Help Titus set up the bomb.
[ES] Ayuda a Titus a colocar la bomba.

[EN] The explosion shakes the entire floor.
[ES] La explosión sacude todo el piso.

[EN] Defeat Kalligar.
[ES] Derrota a Kalligar.

[EN] Go to the 3rd floor and help Elleon
[ES] Ve al tercer piso y ayuda a Elleon

[EN] Head to the center of the 3rd floor.
[ES] Dirígete al centro del tercer piso.

[EN] Hurry to the Main Control System.
[ES] Date prisa hacia el Sistema de Control Principal.

[EN] Destroy the Control System.
[ES] Destruye el Sistema de Control.

[EN] Destroy the Door
[ES] Destruye la puerta

[EN] Follow Elleon
[ES] Sigue a Elleon

[EN] Stop!
[ES] ¡Alto!

[EN] Take out the intruders!
[ES] ¡Elimina a los intrusos!

[EN] You shall not pass!
[ES] ¡No pasarán!

[EN] No...
[ES] No...

[EN] This is bad.
[ES] Esto es malo.

[EN] Is it you this time?
[ES] ¿Eres tú esta vez?
